requirements.label: Environmental Health Science and Science: old curriculum
requirements.details: For Bachelor of Environmental Health Science (08BOHS) and Bachelor of Science (07BASC), the NSSC Old Curriculum column requires 15 APS from Biology, Mathematics and Physical Science, none below C. This is not an IB total or a replacement for other applicable entry rules.

Store this shared condition once; do not extend it to every commerce programme or invent an IB subject conversion.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Alternative school-qualification routes
requirements.details: Degree entry alternatives: three GCE A-level subjects plus two distinct ordinary-level subjects; or two A-levels plus three distinct ordinary-level subjects; or five CSEC General/IGCSE/GCE O-level passes. English is required; Mathematics and major subjects depend on the programme. Ordinary subjects cannot duplicate subjects counted at A-level.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: General accepted grades; stricter programme rules prevail
requirements.details: General notes accept CSEC I–III (III only from June 1998), CAPE I–V, GCE A-level A–E and GCE O-level/IGCSE A–E. CAPE I–III or A-level A–C may earn academic-unit exemptions. Several programme pages require ordinary-level A–C; general A–E is not a universal programme offer.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Missing prescribed subjects: possible qualifying route
requirements.details: Applicants with five passes but missing an acceptable prescribed subject may be allowed a subject qualifying examination or IDCE foundation course. Departments may require foundation courses even where general entry is met; this is not an automatic subject waiver.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Prior accredited tertiary study
requirements.details: CXC Arts/Science associate holders may enter two- or three-year degree routes. Other accredited tertiary qualifications may support year-one/two admission after transcript assessment. Placement and credit are not automatic.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Interview when requested
requirements.details: Applicants may be invited to interview. The general rule does not require an interview for every applicant.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: UGEE not required for ordinarily qualified applicants
requirements.details: Applicants already meeting the relevant CSEC/IGCSE/GCE O-level or other approved entry qualifications are not required to take UGEE. This exemption is conditional on being qualified; it is not a waiver for mature or deficient-entry routes.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: UG Entrance Examination eligibility (undated)

requirements.label: UGEE option while awaiting examination results
requirements.details: Applicants expecting qualifying May/June school-examination passes may opt for UGEE. No numerical pass mark is published on the eligibility page.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: UG Entrance Examination eligibility (undated)

requirements.label: Official application portals by campus/mode
requirements.details: Use the Registry-linked public application service for Turkeyen, Tain/Berbice, or IDCE/distance education as applicable. Course registration by already admitted students is a separate process; no essay count is stated on this portal-selection page.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: Apply to UOG, campus/application services

profiles.notes: Named associate/diploma/certificate routes, including shared Computer Science bachelor/associate conditions. Each fact names its applicable awards; no NQF level or bachelor's equivalence for certificates is assigned. Shared facts are stored once across award levels.

requirements.label: Associate, diploma and certificate school route
requirements.details: The shared standard is five CSEC General/IGCSE/GCE O-level passes including English and Mathematics, subject to the named course's conditions. This is not a bachelor's prerequisite imposed on UTech or other universities.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: CSEC IV/V: certificate bridge, not direct degree entry
requirements.details: Applicants with CSEC IV/V may matriculate through a Guyana certificate programme to become eligible for bachelor's entry. This does not establish direct bachelor's acceptance with those grades.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Computer Science bachelor/associate: school subjects
requirements.details: Both BSc Computer Science and Associate of Science Computer Science specify five CSEC General I–III or IGCSE/GCE O-level A–C subjects including English, Mathematics and CSEC Information Technology. Their IT/EDPM remedial alternative is a separate condition, not a missing-subject rejection.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Computer Science entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Computer Science: IT/EDPM remedial course
requirements.details: Students without CSEC IT or EDPM may be admitted but must register for and pass UGC1101 Computer Literacy I. This is a post-admission course requirement for the two named Computer Science awards, not an exemption from all entry criteria.

source.title: Guyana Registry: Associate of Science Computer Science entry requirements (undated)

profiles.notes: Alternative entry only. Mature-age conflict is unresolved; qualification and programme-specific exceptions retain their own scope. No universal work-duration threshold is inferred.

requirements.label: Mature-age policy: official pages disagree
requirements.details: The Registry general page specifies age 21 in the entry year plus suitable education for mature consideration; https://uog.edu.gy/admission-requirements specifies 26. Both are undated. Computer Science and Nursing pages also say 21 for their own routes. Confirm the applicable age with Admissions; neither value is presented as a reconciled university-wide cutoff.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Mature-entry UGEE
requirements.details: Mature Student category applicants must take UGEE. This is an alternative entry route, not an extra test imposed on ordinarily qualified school-leavers.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: UG Entrance Examination eligibility (undated)

requirements.label: Certificate/diploma entrants: UGEE exceptions
requirements.details: UGEE normally applies to entrants relying on accepted certificates/diplomas. Exceptions include Agriculture diplomas for Agriculture/Forestry; accepted trained-teacher certificates; government technical diplomas for the listed science/technology/medical faculties; IDCE Industrial Relations and Management; Commonwealth Youth Work; and Academic Board approvals. The general page names College of Medical Sciences, while the UGEE page names Health Sciences; confirm the relevant faculty rather than extending an exemption to all courses.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Pre-university and vocational qualifications
requirements.details: Relevant reputable pre-university/IDCE qualifications and recognized CVQ, GROW/SCQF and GED credentials may be considered. The page supplies no universal GED score, vocational grade conversion or guaranteed degree admission.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Computer Science bachelor/associate: shared tertiary alternatives
requirements.details: Both Computer Science pages list a Secondary Mathematics trained-teacher certificate, or a Credit-level GTEE Ordinary Diploma in Computer Science or Science, as alternative qualifications. Stored once for BSc and Associate of Science Computer Science; the BSc's additional computing diploma/associate route is separate.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Computer Science entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Computer Science bachelor/associate: CLC route
requirements.details: For the Computer Science bachelor's and associate courses, a Critchlow Labour College Certificate in Industrial and Social Studies must be accompanied by a UGEE pass. The similarly named IDCE certificate exemption must not be substituted.

source.title: Guyana Registry: Associate of Science Computer Science entry requirements (undated)

profiles.notes: Undated official requirements, checked 30 October 2026; course replacement/introduction dates are not admission years. Shared rules are stored once. Programme-specific conditions may be stricter.

requirements.label: Transfer standing and advanced-credit evidence
requirements.details: Transfer applicants must have been properly admitted to and attending a recognized university degree. Supply a studentship certificate/relevant information; advanced-standing assessment needs transcripts and syllabi of passed courses. Faculty recommendation and university acceptance are required.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Transfer credit and residence limits
requirements.details: Credit requires equivalent courses. At least half of the required courses, including the final year, must be completed at Guyana; previous attendance does not guarantee entry or credit.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Prior Guyana degree: additional-degree credit
requirements.details: Relevant courses from a previous Guyana degree may count toward another degree, normally when the original degree was obtained within five years. At least half the new degree's required courses, including its final year, must still be completed.

source.title: University of Guyana Registry: general admission requirements (undated)

profiles.notes: Undated official requirements, checked 30 October 2026; course replacement/introduction dates are not admission years. Shared rules are stored once. Programme-specific conditions may be stricter.

requirements.label: BSc Computer Science: computing diploma/associate alternative
requirements.details: The BSc also accepts a Diploma in Computer Science, Associate of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology or Information Systems. The duplicated equivalence sentences on its source page represent one equivalence assessment, not separate requirements.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Computer Science entry requirements (undated)

profiles.notes: Professional-entry Nursing routes require RN/Medex registration. Do not present this page as a direct school-leaver pre-registration Nursing offer. The source is undated.

requirements.label: Nursing professional registration route
requirements.details: Every listed academic route also requires Registered Nurse certification recognized by both Guyana's Nursing Council and the university, or a Guyana Medex completion certificate plus registration to practise as a Medex. RN applicants also registered as midwives receive preference; midwifery registration is not universally mandatory.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Nursing professional-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Nursing academic alternatives
requirements.details: Alternatives alongside professional registration: five CSEC I–III (III from 1998)/IGCSE/GCE A–C passes including English, Mathematics and a science; or GTI Ordinary Diploma in Science with Credit plus three such passes including those subjects; or a Natural Science trained-teacher certificate plus three such passes including English and Mathematics. Equivalent qualifications require assessment.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Nursing professional-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Nursing mature alternative: age, work and UGEE
requirements.details: The mature route specifies age 21+, at least five years of relevant work and a UGEE pass, together with the professional registration condition above. Five years' work is not required of every academic-route applicant or every Guyana applicant.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Nursing professional-entry requirements (undated)

profiles.notes: Higher-entry Architecture routes. 'From 2020' in the programme name and 2025/2026 course changes are not a published admissions cycle.

requirements.label: Architecture: prior diploma/associate route
requirements.details: Guyana's Architecture and Building Technology diploma or Architectural and Building Technology associate, or equivalent, requires GPA at least 2.0 and ARH2205 (or equivalent) at least C. A lower ARH2205 grade may be improved by repeating the course. The diploma and associate alternatives share this rule, stored once.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Architecture higher-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Other technical qualifications: transcript and 5–10 works
requirements.details: Applicants with relevant regional/international tertiary technical qualifications must submit a certified transcript and a portfolio of 5–10 artwork/design examples. The page lists architectural drawings and other visual-design media; it does not require an example of every medium.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Architecture higher-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Portfolio authorship verification
requirements.details: The technical-qualification portfolio must be accompanied by letters verifying that the work is the applicant's own. This is tied to that portfolio route, not a universal recommendation-letter count.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Architecture higher-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.label: Architecture interview if requested
requirements.details: Candidates may be asked for an in-person or virtual interview. The page does not say every candidate must interview or receive automatic entry into a specified study year.

source.title: Guyana Registry: BSc Architecture higher-entry requirements (undated)

requirements.details: Second-year passes in a science-based programme (e.g. Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Environmental Studies), or in a College of Medical Sciences programme (e.g. Allied Health, Pharmacy, Rehabilitation, Optometry), require overall GPA at least 3.4.

requirements.label: MBBS: prior Nursing/science degree alternatives
requirements.details: A recognized BSc Nursing with overall GPA at least 3.4, or a science-based first degree with at least Credit and overall GPA at least 3.4, may qualify. The university assesses other equivalent qualifications.

source.title: Guyana MBBS programme 5207D: academic year 2026/2027 admission criteria

requirements.label: MBBS minimums do not guarantee selection
requirements.details: Selection also ranks overall grades and subject performance against available quota/category places. The college may apply the GPA mode for the particular matriculation year. Meeting one published alternative does not guarantee admission.
